mechanismNotes.finding: Terrain collision damage is capped at 190 per consequence and only begins above deltaV 8.
Concussion Cannon M supplies 920 momentum per hit: about 57.5 wu/s on the light hull and 15.333333 wu/s on the medium hull before contact response.
Across displacement runs: 20 collision-attributed kills, 20 direct-weapon-attributed kills, 0 survivals.
